changelog:
Initial release of aws-health skill to monitor AWS EC2 and ECS health.

- Reports running/stopped counts, CPU/memory metrics, and unhealthy ECS tasks.
- Supports targeted checks: EC2 only, ECS only, or by ECS cluster.
- Structured output formatted for chat readability.
- Robust error handling for common AWS authentication and permission issues.
- Requires AWS credentials and region configuration.
summary: Check health of AWS EC2 instances and ECS clusters/services. Reports running/stopped counts, CPU/memory metrics, and unhealthy tasks. Use when the user asks...
